fields.label: Location
fields.note: The portal's only facet (facetedSearchConfig.facets: fieldName text1, displayName 'Location') is country-level; facet request field not confirmed, so location is matched locally against the country/city strings.

notes: www.persistent.com/careers/ redirects to the company portal careers.persistent.com (Angular SPA, Zwayam tenant; 685 rows, 9 per page behind 'Show More'). The listing is POST https://public.zwayam.com/jobs/search with multipart fields filterCri (JSON criteria), domain=careers.persistent.com and companyId=MTYzNDQ=; the criteria object carries paginationStartNo, selectedCall, sortCriteria and anyOfTheseWords. Verified live: anyOfTheseWords='engineer' returns totalCount 241 versus 685 unfiltered. The request's default sort is modifiedDate descending. No keyword/facet URL parameter exists, so everything else (city, department, employment type) is filtered locally from the listing rows.
evidence: https://public.zwayam.com/jobs/search POST filterCri={"anyOfTheseWords":"",...} -> totalCount 685, facets: Location (India 623, United States 46, ...)
